description: Type & Capacity: Desert air cooler with 80 L capacity, ideal for commercial and home use, providing efficient cooling and comfort in hot weather. Large tank capacity: Provides extended cooling duration, reducing the hassle of frequent water refills for uninterrupted comfort. Powerful air delivery: Moves a high volume of air efficiently, ensuring effective cooling for larger areas and better circulation. Dual Flow Technology: Dual Flow honeycombs ensure complete pad wetting, enabling faster cooling performance and more consistent air flow during operation. Ice chamber: Dedicated ice chamber boosts cooling efficiency, delivering instant refreshing and ultra-cool air for quick relief. 3-Side Chill Drip Technology: Ice-cold water from the ice chamber flows directly onto three honeycomb pads for faster and more powerful cooling. Bacteria Shield Honeycomb Pads Technology : Offers efficient cooling and healthier air circulation with advanced honeycomb pads that reduce bacteria and allergens by 99.9%, ensuring cleaner, healthier, and fresher air circulation. Bed Height Fan Position: Thoughtfully designed to direct airflow at bed level, making it ideal for bedrooms and living spaces for enhanced comfort. Multi-Directional Castor Wheels: 360-degree rotating wheels enable easy movement, while front castors with brakes provide stability and prevent unwanted shifting. Thermal Overload Protection: Built-in safety feature prevents damage to the pump and motor by automatically shutting down in case of short-circuit, overheating or overload.
